ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) central regions occupy approximately 65-70% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral borders and a central vertical median column.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly triangular high-intensity white blobs centered on the left and right lobes. These are bounded by a continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and a thick dark vertical band originating from the peduncle and widening into the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged peaks with pixel heights of approximately 5-10 units alternate with irregular valleys, creating a rough, saw-tooth boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges, terminating in sharp, slightly downward-turned lateral tips (lobes).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of small, circular low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters within the white central zones. Small high-intensity (white) circular clusters are visible on the far-left dark tip area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark or scratch) is visible on the mid-right lobe, extending diagonally from the inner notch area towards the outer edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark diagonal scar on the right lobe. Irregular indentation/missing segment on the upper portion of the left lobe's outer edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge displays an asymmetrical serration pattern, with the left lobe exhibiting more pronounced, larger peaks compared to the right lobe.
